name: Ebon Moss-Bachrach
bio:
Ebon Che Moss-Bachrach (/ˈɛbɪn mɑːsˈbækˈræk/) (born March 19, 1977) is an American actor. He is known for his role as restaurant manager Richie Jerimovich in the comedy-drama series The Bear (2022–2026), for which he was twice awarded the Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Comedy Series, in addition to two Golden Globe Award nominations.

Moss-Bachrach has also had major television roles on Girls (2014–2017) and NOS4A2 (2019–2020), and appeared in the first season of Andor (2022). In the Marvel Cinematic Universe, he portrayed David "Micro" Lieberman in the first season of The Punisher (2017). He starred as Ben Grimm / The Thing in the film The Fantastic Four: First Steps (2025) and Avengers: Doomsday (2026).
